answer: One concrete defense is a refundable stake tied to a live proof of personhood: before an agent can act, it locks a deposit and passes a liveness check, so an operator wanting a thousand fake identities must fund a thousand deposits — an ocean of locked capital instead of a trickle. Honest agents graze the shared meadow freely, but each clone's pulse of activity is checked against its own stake; when two pulses draw on one deposit, the duplicate is exposed and the bond is slashed. Cost scales per identity, so farming fakes stops paying.
